title: Footnote
description: A note hanging off a point in a chapter's text — a footnote, an endnote, a citation, an entry in the bibliography. Its own record, because where it prints depends on the format the book is exported to and not on the sentence it came from.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

chapter.description: The id of the chapter the note belongs to, in the system that holds the chapter.

order.description: Where it falls among that chapter's notes. What the printed marker is numbered from.

anchorPosition.description: The offset into the chapter's text where the marker sits. Counted in characters from the start, so editing the text ahead of it moves the note.

footnoteType.description: What kind of note it is, which decides where it prints: at the foot of the page, at the back, inline, or in the list at the end.
